description: Asks the DAO Field Type, Size and Attributes (and first-row Value) of the column that a text-producing function or concatenation yields, including results of 255, 256, 300 and 5000 characters, Replace that grows past 255, $ forms, Null-returning forms, and text from Nz and IIf. Each expression is its own snapshot SELECT expr AS v FROM One. Fixture r-expr-1b-main is opened read-only through DAO.DBEngine.120; engine version and the loaded modules (once) are recorded; each recordset reads Name, Type and Value of every field.
